purpose: Compile every demonstrated conventional route into an RDG-Maxwell defect detector and define the held-out residual gate.

terms.K_total: carrier plus geometry, material, source, boundary and bath response

conventionalChannels.ordinaryMechanism: selector does not commute with d
charge and current selectors are inconsistent
spatially varying resonance mixes field/material sectors
projection is metric-safe but not chain-safe, or converse
conventionalChannels.detector: chain, retract, metric and adjoint residuals

conventionalChannels.ordinaryMechanism: global class changes address at a cut
conventionalChannels.detector: boundary mismatch, Wilson circulation or cap flux
conventionalChannels.failureWitness: discarding boundary/gluing data makes reconstruction many-to-one

conventionalChannels.ordinaryMechanism: energy exits through an unmeasured bath or returns outside the observation window
conventionalChannels.failureWitness: finite bath gives full recurrence at 2pi
conventionalChannels.status: exact port balance and recurrence counterexample

decisionRule.rejectNewPhysicsWhen: any conventional channel explains the held-out amplitude, phase, frequency dependence, scaling or energy flow within its declared uncertainty
retainAnomalyWhen: the preparation and selector commute with the gauge complex
geometry, constitutive and resonant transfer matrices are independently calibrated
source continuity and both Gauss records close
boundary, topology and remesh receipts retain all global records
detector cross-talk, noise and phase lag are calibrated on held-out configurations
port power and return channels close the energy budget
a preregistered residual survives reversal, scaling, frequency and independent-detector tests
decisionRule.promoteToNewPhysicsOnlyWhen: the retained residual also conflicts with the complete conventional model in a reproducible way and a typed extension improves held-out predictions

suggestedExperiment.platform: same-device three-mode coherent network, with thin-film lithium niobate as one practical implementation
suggestedExperiment.preparation: two settings with identical pairwise coupling magnitudes and opposite closed-loop phase
suggestedExperiment.heldOutTest: fit nuisance parameters without the target phase configuration, then predict its full complex response before unblinding

statusSummary.claim: A nonzero defect signal is a sensitive relational measurement, not a self-authenticating anomaly.

verdict: The RDG-Maxwell arm now supplies a complete first-pass nuisance ladder. New physics begins only at the reproducible held-out residual after all eight typed conventional channels are bounded; Q-sector power alone is evidence only of symmetry-relative transfer.
